# Scene mapping — photoreal website ↔ 3D model (generated by tests/unit/catalog.test.ts)

Routes: `#/<lang>/visual/<sceneId>` (photo site, `home` = overview) · `#/<lang>/<explore|tour|design|amenities>?f=&u=&r=&v=` (3D).
Shared state: locale, sound (muted by default), time of day, floor, unit, room. Scenes come from the same camera list as the Cycles renders (`src/domain/views.ts`).
